title: Change the details on a property certificate or licence
summary: Learn how to notify NSW Fair Trading of changes to your property certificate or licence details.
intro:
If your details have changed you must notify NSW Fair Trading within 14 days if you hold a:

Corporation licence holders must notify NSW Fair Trading of changes to the licensee in charge within 5 business days.

To check your property licence or certificate details, visit Verify NSW.
who_can_apply: Individuals or corporations who hold a property certificate or licence and whose details have changed.
what_you_need: The relevant form for the change (e.g., Change of Details: Property certificate or licence, Change of Director: Corporation property licence, or Notification of Licensee in Charge Details).
Evidence of the changed details as stated on the form.
A method to submit the completed form (Service NSW Centre).

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the relevant form.

faqs.q: How quickly must I notify NSW Fair Trading of changes?
faqs.a: If your details have changed, you must notify NSW Fair Trading within 14 days. Corporation licence holders must notify NSW Fair Trading of changes to the licensee in charge within 5 business days.

faqs.q: Where can I check my property licence or certificate details?
faqs.a: You can check your property licence or certificate details by visiting Verify NSW.

faqs.q: What do I need to submit a change of details?
faqs.a: You need the relevant form, supporting documents proving the change, and the specific form based on the type of change.
